target: Specify operational terms and boundaries for human feedback using a feedback-to-policy update record. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Define human feedback — human review
competency.outcome: Specify operational terms and boundaries for human feedback using a feedback-to-policy update record. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: assuming one person's preference is universal

competency.practice_task: Produce a glossary with a positive and a negative case grounded in a feedback-to-policy update record.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a glossary with a positive and a negative case
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report improvement and disagreement rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: assuming one person's preference is universal.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of human feedback.
Practice: the definitions separate valid from invalid cases.
Measurement: report improvement and disagreement rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for assuming one person's preference is universal; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
